coverage: 2000-present: PEMA's linked proclamation history from 2018, plus 2001-2017 storm disaster proclamations (Ridge, Rendell, Corbett and Wolf) added by hand from the Pennsylvania Bulletin, PEMA records and press coverage; no dated proclamation has been found yet for November 2006, April 2011 or summer 2013 (DR-1684, DR-4003, DR-4149), and the August 2004 storms (DR-1538) match only through the September 2004 Frances proclamation
